title: Help Scout Review (2026)
intro: Help Scout is evaluated here as a helpdesk / ticketing platform — Help Scout is an SMB-focused shared inbox and helpdesk for email-centric support teams. Free plan for up to 5 users; paid annual per-user pricing: Standard $25, Plus $45, Pro $75 per user/month billed annually. AI Answers billed at $0.75 per resolution on usage. Not an enterprise omnichannel peer of Zendesk Suite — scored inside helpdesk-ticketing for SMB shared-inbox fit. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse's customer-service methodology (ease of use, support job fit, workflow depth, omnichannel, self-service, integrations, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Help Scout when SMB shared-inbox simplicity and docs-first self-service matter more than enterprise omnichannel voice and social depth.
verdict: Choose Help Scout when SMB shared-inbox simplicity and docs-first self-service matter more than enterprise omnichannel voice and social depth. Compare Freshdesk or Zendesk Suite for omnichannel scale, and Zoho Desk for lower per-agent pricing on larger teams. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.
